title: Workers' Compensation Referral Programs: Weekly Frequency, Daily Hours and Length
content:
# Program dosage standards — Workers' Compensation Referral

Each program of the Workers' Compensation Referral has its own dosage limits: the most visits or program days in a Monday-to-Sunday week, the minimum and maximum program hours per day for hour-billed programs, the longest the program may run from its first treatment date, and whether visits may be delivered by telehealth.

| Program | Maximum visits or program days per week | Minimum program hours per day | Maximum program hours per day | Maximum program length (weeks) | Telehealth allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Employer Direct Early Intervention | 2 | 0 | 0 | 3 | No |
| Workers' Comp Outpatient Therapy | 3 | 0 | 0 | 8 | Yes |
| Workers' Comp Post-Surgical Therapy | 3 | 0 | 0 | 12 | Yes |
| Work Conditioning Program | 5 | 2 | 4 | 6 | No |
| Work Hardening Program | 5 | 4 | 8 | 8 | No |
| Functional Capacity Evaluation | 2 | 0 | 4 | 1 | No |

## Definitions

- **Maximum visits or program days per week** — the most visits or program days the program allows in one Monday-to-Sunday week.
- **Minimum and maximum program hours per day** — for an hour-billed program, the least and the most program hours in one day; both are 0 for programs billed by the visit.
- **Maximum program length** — the longest the program runs, in weeks, counted from the first treatment date.
- **Telehealth allowed** — whether visits under the program may be delivered by telehealth.

## Notes on the figures

- Work Conditioning Program runs between 2 and 4 program hours a day for up to 6 weeks; Work Hardening Program between 4 and 8 hours a day for up to 8 weeks. Both allow 5 program days a week.
- Functional Capacity Evaluation has no daily minimum (0) and a daily maximum of 4 hours, at most 2 days a week, within 1 week.
- The visit-billed programs list 0 for both daily hour figures: Employer Direct Early Intervention (2 visits a week, 3 weeks), Workers' Comp Outpatient Therapy (3 visits a week, 8 weeks) and Workers' Comp Post-Surgical Therapy (3 visits a week, 12 weeks).
- Telehealth is allowed only in Workers' Comp Outpatient Therapy and Workers' Comp Post-Surgical Therapy.
